segments.sn5.7:1.2: Atha kho upacālā bhikkhunī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā … pe … aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
segments.sn5.7:1.4: Atha kho māro pāpimā yena upacālā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā upacālaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn5.7:2.1: “Tāvatiṃsā ca yāmā ca, tusitā cāpi devatā;
segments.sn5.7:3.1: “Tāvatiṃsā ca yāmā ca, tusitā cāpi devatā;
segments.sn5.7:4.1: “Sabbo ādīpito [sabbova āditto (syā. kaṃ.)] loko, sabbo loko padhūpito;
segments.sn5.7:4.3: Sabbo pajjalito [pajjalito (sabbattha)] loko, sabbo loko pakampito.
segments.sn5.7:5.3: Agati yattha mārassa, tattha me nirato mano”ti.
segments.sn5.7:6.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā “jānāti maṃ upacālā bhikkhunī”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.

lines: Sattame enti māravasaṃ punāti punappunaṃ maraṇamārakilesamāradevaputtamārānaṃ vasaṃ āgacchanti.
Agati yattha mārassāti yattha tuyhaṃ mārassa agati.
